note: Two-door cut (2026-10-26): sketch + page first (aha in 30 s), then a banner with the overflow question, limits, results. One live capture: capture/full.mjs.

beats.text: Every campaign ships the same ad in a dozen shapes and languages, and someone rebuilds each one by hand.
So I start from a rough sketch, and point at the product page. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads the boxes I drew, and Tavily reads the page.
beats.say: So I start from a rough sketch, and point at the product page. Nemotron three point five Super V L reads the boxes I drew, and Tavily reads the page.

beats.onScreen: Facts from your page, with their quotes
beats.text: Nemotron 3 Super lifts the facts from the page, each with the quote it came from, and drafts headlines from those facts only. A headline with a number or a name that is not on the page is thrown away.
beats.say: Nemotron three Super lifts the facts from the page, each with the quote it came from, and drafts headlines from those facts only. A headline with a number or a name that is not on the page is thrown away.

beats.onScreen: Your pictures, your colours, built as layers
beats.text: I add my own logo and product picture, pick a colour, and build. The banner is rebuilt as editable layers, and adapted to a story card.

beats.onScreen: Checked independently, and against your page
beats.text: Fourteen independent checks pass. And a page check compares the price on the banner with your page. Here it matches. If it did not, the app would say so.

beats.onScreen: Banners you already have work too
beats.text: Banners you already have work too. Nemotron reads the parts, and I drag the boxes it got wrong.
A long German headline does not fit the card. A blind tool would squeeze it. This one stops, renders both options for real, and Nemotron 3 Super words the question.
beats.say: A long German headline does not fit the card. A blind tool would squeeze it. This one stops, renders both options for real, and Nemotron three Super words the question.

beats.text: I pick split, and the independent verifier re-checks the result. For my own banner there is no authored answer, and the app says so instead of counting one.
It also says what it cannot do: flat backgrounds, one font, sixteen by nine only, and no generated pictures. Sketch reading was only partly right on our tests, which is why you confirm the boxes.
The numbers, and the failures, are in the repository. Open Apprentice: bring a banner or a sketch, and trust the result.
